models.class_tagged_disclosure_filter: Adds the 5-minute class-tagged positioning state variables (nt, na, d_nt, d_na, div_t = nt - na) demeaned relative to the causal trailing 12-bar (60-minute) baseline.
models.price_flow_filter_baseline: OLS with symbol fixed effects on (q_shock, ret_shock, xf, xs, uf, us), where xf, xs and uf, us are fast (alpha=0.50) and slow (alpha=0.10) exponential memory filters of 5-minute returns and normalized signed order flow.

motivation: P1_disclosure_oos (f0182ce5) tested raw signed 30-minute price changes dp_30m after top-decile flow shocks and failed (-1.089 pts) because directional 30-minute returns are near-martingale noise. Theorem thm:merged directly predicts that price-and-flow filters cannot recover class-specific memory states or cross-cohort positioning divergence, whereas class-tagged disclosures identify the distinct cohort state trajectories.

primary_1_cohort_divergence_30m.criterion: Out-of-sample delta_R2 (tagged vs price_flow) > 0, Clark-West one-sided p < 0.025 (Holm-adjusted across primaries), and 95% date-block bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 (2,000 draws).
primary_1_cohort_divergence_30m.outcome: fut_div_30m = (n_top[t+6] - bar_n_top[t]) - (n_all[t+6] - bar_n_all[t]) (30-minute post-shock cross-cohort state divergence, bp scale)

primary_2_top_trader_state_30m.criterion: Out-of-sample delta_R2 (tagged vs price_flow) > 0, Clark-West one-sided p < 0.025 (Holm-adjusted across primaries), and 95% date-block bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 (2,000 draws).
primary_2_top_trader_state_30m.outcome: fut_nt_30m = n_top[t+6] - bar_n_top[t] (30-minute post-shock institutional/top-trader positioning state, bp scale)

secondary_all_bars: Same out-of-sample delta_R2 comparisons across all 5-minute bars t in [12, 275].
shock_definition: Top-decile 5-minute normalized signed flow shocks |q5[t]| >= Q_0.90_train(|q5|) for bars t in [12, 275] (secondary: all 5-minute bars t in [12, 275]).
theory_reference: Theorem thm:merged (non-identifiability of cohort states from prices/aggregate flow alone) and Proposition prop:tagged (exact state recovery under class-tagged disclosures)
